audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with their own why text: row 0 read Skill while whys[0] says Sett's base stats win level 1; row 2 read Skill while whys[2] says you all-in cleanly; row 3 read Swain while whys[3] calls it skill-dependent; row 4 read Skill while whys[4] says Demonic Ascension tips extended fights to Swain.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Sett, Skill, Sett, Skill, Swain, Swain, Swain — identical to what the prose already claims.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet across both layers with ratings adjusted, and phases[4].why rewritten so level 6 reads as Swain's stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was framed as Sett's Show Stopper spike; it is Swain's Demonic Ascension spike, and no cooldown was given for either.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s, drains from every nearby champion, minion and monster, and shortens Nevermove's cooldown while active.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns carry the 120s and the E-cooldown reduction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nevermove was described as 'a returning bolt that roots enemies it hits' but the page never said the root only happens on the RETURN pass — and the whole lane is dodging it.
audit.why: Riot's text: Swain launches the wave forward, it then returns to him and roots enemies it hits. The outgoing wave does not root, so you must clear the line twice, and the pull only follows a landed root.
audit.corrected: Stated in report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns with the 12s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and late both credit Swain with 'Soul Shackles'.
audit.why: Soul Shackles is Leona's ultimate. Swain's R recast is Demonflare, a nova that damages and slows.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] says 'Stack pure HP' but the description underneath was boilerplate about burning a cooldown.
audit.why: Ravenous Flock heals him and permanently raises his max health, and his damage keys off health totals — raw HP is the wrong answer; Grievous Wounds is.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d rewritten around Executioner's Calling, which report[8] already lists as the first back.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain. Don’t fight into it. Track it before every engage. - Swain Nevermove: A returning bolt that roots enemies it hits — his catch tool. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Swain Nevermove: 12s at rank 1 — it roots on the RETURN pass, not the way out, so step off the line twice, not once. - Swain Demonic Ascension: 120s, and it shortens his E cooldown while it is up.

edits.before: His drain. Don’t fight into it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 120s. It heals off your minions too — fight him away from the wave.

edits.before: Track Swain's Demonic Ascension: His drain. Don’t fight into it. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Nevermove roots on the return pass, not the throw — sidestep twice, then E-stun into the W panel.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Swain doesn't want. Suplex him into your wave or tower, never into his own minions.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension is 120s and drains off everything nearby — suplex him away from your wave, and only with Executioner's already bought.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His drain scales with your health, so raw HP feeds it — Executioner's first.

edits.before: Fully stacked Swain out-sustains and out-ranges you — Demonic Ascension plus Soul Shackles chunks your health bar every fight from a safe distance.
edits.after: Fully stacked Swain out-sustains and out-ranges you — Demonic Ascension plus its Demonflare nova chunks your health bar every fight from range.

edits.before: With items and stacks Swain out-sustains, out-ranges, and out-teamfights you; his ult heal and Soul Shackles make him the stronger scaling pick.
edits.after: With items and stacks Swain out-sustains, out-ranges, and out-teamfights you; his drain and Demonflare nova make him the stronger scaling pick.

notes: 'Soul Shackles' appeared twice on this page as a Swain ability — it is Leona's ultimate. Worth grepping the repo for it across other Swain matchups. Also note the header contradiction left as-is because it is not in my writable set: diff reads FAV and tone is the red #ff5d6c, while report[14] calls it a hard matchup at 7/10 difficulty; with a 54.45% win rate the FAV label is the defensible one and the tone colour is the outlier.
